content.short: Solve3 provides bot protection for smart contracts by embedding captchas into transactions.
content.description: Solve3 helps prevent bot manipulation in web3, especially during NFT mints, gaming events, and token sales. By embedding captchas into smart contract transactions, it creates a robust barrier that makes automated bot activity harder and protects user participation. This approach ties human verification to the transaction flow, reducing the advantage bots gain during critical moments and preserving fair access for legitimate users. Developers can integrate Solve3 with ease, delivering a safer, more reliable experience across blockchain applications while addressing bot-related issues.
